rules.identityNotId: MET with correction: ID + creation within 10000 ticks (1 ms inclusive); same identity with different executable refuses
rules.self: MET: own ID, start time and $PSHOME pwsh.exe excluded only on ID + creation match; wrong executable refuses; self ID with different creation not exempt
rules.missingIdentity: MET for known identities: missing/invalid ID, creation or executable in parent, CMD, observer, case or worker records refuses; 7-digit creation strings; pre-1970 or unspecified-kind refuses
rules.observerGate: MET: -ObserverGateSha256 must equal gate hash before read; status, group, admission, observer ID, exit 0, EOF, stdout hash checked; rehashed after quiets; caller passes its captured gate hash and requires echo
rules.schemeWorker: MET: parent==runner counts only if created within runner lifetime +/- 1 ms; else reused parent; missing runner exit refuses
rules.retainedRows: MET: raw ID, parent ID, creation and executable plus classification kept per quiet; refusal writes one CLOSURE_IDENTITY_REFUSAL JSON line
rules.unchangedLimits: MET: two quiets, 500 ms, 1 s query timeout, 10 s closure, post-pins, outer-success and case checks unchanged

requiredCorrection.change: validate ID, parent ID and creation first; classify self, known, worker-child or reuse from them; require a valid matching executable only for rows whose ID and creation match self or a known identity; for reused-ID or reused-parent rows record any executable but neither require nor format-validate it; missing or invalid creation still refuses for every row
requiredCorrection.why: rows that are only reused IDs currently refuse as CLOSURE_IDENTITY_UNKNOWN whenever Windows hides the path (SYSTEM or other-user processes), restoring a reuse false failure; no false pass either way
